playbooks.description: Every rendered Broadcast reading exposes a qualifier.
Broadcast renders the measured funnel beat and conversion-funnel composition.
Hide mode contains no illustrative figures and explains the empty measured state.

Navigates to /broadcast in mark mode and asserts illustrative readings render as hollow or dotted figures carrying a qualifier, with the legend on screen (CC-UI-002). Provenance is material, never a red chip.

Renders Broadcast's densest beat: a panel hero over fourteen readings at 1280x720 and asserts the room reports data-fit='ok': no figure leaves the screen and the hero never runs into the strip. A landscape room never scrolls (CC-P1-017).
Broadcast renders one verdict row per experiment arm.
Navigates to /broadcast and verifies the ThemeProvider applies data-theme='signal-tower'. Console output is captured by the runner's console-logs artifact.

Navigates to /broadcast and asserts the scene surface reports a painted first frame: the engine samples its own canvas and stamps data-scene-state='ready' only when pixels were drawn (CC-UI-003). A mounted scene that draws nothing is a failure.
Broadcast identifies the active LPBS source origin.

Navigates to /forge (all-live-metrics dashboard) and asserts the MetricList wrapper renders at least one [data-metric-id] entry.

Renders The Forge's Next Rung beat, which omits the supporting strip, at 1280x720 and asserts the room reports data-fit='ok': no figure leaves the screen and the hero never runs into the strip. A landscape room never scrolls (CC-P1-017).
